rationale: The visual dashboard has multiple plausible audiences. The first coherent product slice is the operator actively driving DontPanic work and needing to know what action is required now.

decision: Build a shared ActionItem provider before rendering the What Now view.
rationale: Gates, capabilities, reconcile drift, supervisors, and future architecture drift all have different native vocabularies. A shared action model prevents duplicated next-action prose and gives agents the same cache shape as humans.

decision: Use a localhost server for V0 operator use while still writing cache files.
rationale: Unlike one-shot architecture HTML, the operating console is consumed continuously while the operator runs commands. Localhost serve with watch/refresh is justified, while cache files preserve headless/agent consumption and avoid HTTP-only coupling.

Kanban implies interactive state transitions. V0 is read-only and local-first; governed remote mutation belongs to Firebase/realtime V2. Read-only boards should be called operator or mission boards, not kanban.

Plan 2026-05-22-003 already shipped capability rendering and MCP status. This V0 console consumes that substrate and integrates capability ActionItems into a wider operating view instead of creating a parallel capability UI.

decision: Keep architecture page and Firebase out of V0.
rationale: Architecture HTML serves overview/newcomer/auditor use cases and Firebase serves shared realtime operation. Neither helps the V0 operator answer what action is required now.
